cuemymusic.config.title: Cue My Music
cuemymusic.option.pitch.tooltip: Shifts pitch without changing speed. 12 semitones is one octave.
cuemymusic.option.tempo_mode.tooltip:
Multiplier: play every song at the same speed factor.
BPM offset: add or remove BPM from each song's detected tempo.
cuemymusic.option.speed.tooltip: Used in Multiplier mode. 1.2 is 20% faster. Changes speed without changing pitch. 0.5 to 2.0.
cuemymusic.option.bpm_offset.tooltip: Used in BPM offset mode. Songs without a clear beat are treated as 120 BPM.
cuemymusic.option.music.tooltip: Menu, overworld, Nether, End and other background music.
